builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: Mostly Shadow spells: you hurt enemies from a distance with damage that keeps ticking while you cast the next spell. Shadowform comes in your 40s.
builds.gear: Intellect first, then Spirit and Stamina. Use a staff or a wand, and gear that adds Spell Damage.

why.Wand Specialization: Your wand does more damage, so it is free damage when your mana runs out.
why.Shadow Focus: Your Shadow spells miss less often.
why.Blackout: Your Shadow damage spells sometimes stun the enemy for a moment.
why.Improved Mind Blast: Mind Blast is ready again much sooner, so you can use it more.
why.Improved Shadow Word: Pain: Shadow Word: Pain lasts longer, so you cast it less often.
why.Mind Flay: A spell you hold down that hurts the enemy and slows how fast it moves.
why.Improved Mind Flay: Each tick of Mind Flay hits harder than the one before it.
why.Vampiric Embrace: Heals your party from your Shadow damage, and it opens Shadowform.
why.Shadow Weaving: Each Shadow spell makes the enemy take more Shadow damage from you.
why.Darkness: All your Shadow damage goes up.
why.Shadowform: Your Shadow spells hurt more and cost half the Mana, and you take less Physical damage.
why.Twin Disciplines: Your instant spells do more damage and healing.
why.Mental Strength: More Intellect, which means a bigger pool of mana.
why.Meditation: Part of your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast.
why.Inner Focus: A button that makes your next spell free and more likely to crit.
why.Dark Inspiration: Mind Blast and a full Mind Flay raise your and your party's Spirit for a while.

fight: Put Shadow Word: Pain on the enemy first, then use Mind Blast whenever it is ready.
Use Smite to fill the gaps. Put Power Word: Shield on yourself before a hard fight.
Hurt after a fight? Rest and let your health and mana fill up before the next one.
Mind Flay
Hold Mind Flay between Mind Blasts. It also slows the enemy so it reaches you later.
Shadowform
Turn on Shadowform before you pull, so every Shadow spell costs less mana.
Inner Focus
Out of mana in a long fight? Press Inner Focus so your next spell is free.
Losing a fight? Put Power Word: Shield on yourself and back away.

builds.name: Dungeon healer
builds.suits: You keep your party alive in a dungeon, mostly with Holy healing. Renew heals over time, and Power Word: Shield stops a hit before it lands.
builds.gear: Intellect first, then Spirit and Stamina. Use a staff, a wand, or a held item that adds healing.

why.Improved Renew: Renew heals more on every target.
why.Twilight Focus: Spells are less likely to be slowed down when you get hit.
why.Spell Warding: You take less damage from enemy spells.
why.Divine Fury: Heal and Greater Heal cast faster, so hurt allies get help sooner.
why.Blessed Recovery: After a big hit on you, you heal yourself for a while.
why.Improved Healing: Heal, Greater Heal and Prayer of Mending cost less mana.
why.Holy Binding: Flash Heal on a friend also heals you.
why.Litany of Light: Mana comes back when you mix different heals.
why.Spirit of Redemption: If you die you can still heal for a short time, and it opens Prayer of Mending.
why.Spiritual Guidance: Your Spirit makes your healing stronger.
why.Prayer of Mending: A heal that jumps from one ally to the next as they take damage.
why.Twin Disciplines: Your instant spells, such as Renew, heal for more.
why.Mental Strength: More Intellect, which means a bigger pool of mana.
why.Mental Agility: Renew and your other instant spells cost less mana.
why.Improved Power Word: Shield: Your Power Word: Shield soaks up more damage.
why.Meditation: Part of your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast.
why.Inner Focus: A button that makes your next heal free and more likely to crit.

fight: Watch your party's health bars. Heal whoever is lowest.
Put Renew on anyone who keeps taking damage. Power Word: Shield stops a hit before it lands.
Use Lesser Heal to top people up, and Heal (level 16) for bigger heals. Skip it if no one is hurt.
Divine Fury
Use Heal on the player taking hits. It is quicker to cast now.
Prayer of Mending
Put Prayer of Mending on the tank. It jumps by itself as they take damage.
Inner Focus
A big hit and your mana is low? Press Inner Focus, then cast a heal for free.
Mana low? Stop and drink, or ask the party to wait for you.
